messages:
elena (prod): FYI — RCA for yesterday's serving degradation is up. TL;DR: a race in the capacity reclamation timer combined with an edge autoscaler path caused rapid fallback cycling which spiked tail latency for ~18 minutes. RCA: https://redwood.internal/docs/rca/1812345678 (internal)
incident-bot: Postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/docs/rca/1812345678 :page_with_curl:
tomas (oncall): Thanks for writing this up. I reviewed the proposed action items. I'll own A1 (autoscaler race fix). Plan: add a short reproducer and land a hotfix + test. ETA 2026-04-05.
noah (eng-runtime): I'll pick up A2 (KV cache invalidation checks + metric). Going to add an integration test and a burn-in for the cache codepath. ETA 2026-03-30. Will post PRs to #eng-runtime.
kevin (sre): I'll execute A3 (safer rollout + gating) and run a canary with stricter health checks. Checkpoint scheduled 2026-03-26 10:00 PT — I'll post the monitoring dashboard link beforehand.
elena (prod): Summary of action items (copied into the doc):
```
A1: Fix autoscaler reclamation race — owner: @tomas — ETA 2026-04-05
A2: Add KV cache invalidation integration tests & metric — owner: @noah — ETA 2026-03-30
A3: Safer rollout gating + heartbeat checks — owner: @kevin — Checkpoint 2026-03-26 10:00 PT
A4: Customer comms draft — owner: @elena — ETA EOD today
```
elena (prod): Also scheduling a follow-up checkpoint meeting: 2026-03-27 09:00 PT — 30m. Please add any blockers to the doc.
jordan (ceo): Appreciate the clear RCA and owners. Please make sure customer-facing note is ready by EOD and include a short FAQ for customers on dedicated capacity behavior. :thumbsup:
tomas (oncall): noted. I'll include reproducer steps in the PR and tag @eng-sre for review.
noah (eng-runtime): Quick note — adding a metric called `kv_invalidate_failures` and a dashboard. Will post links in the doc when ready.
kevin (sre): I've flagged a temporary mitigation: increase the min-pool-size on the autoscaler to avoid immediate reclamation spikes. Will revert after fix. Posting the mitigation steps in the runbook.
elena (prod): Thanks all. If anyone is blocked, ping me directly. Action items and current status are the single source of truth in the RCA doc. :spiral_notepad:
incident-bot: RCA document updated with action-item statuses — 3 items open, 1 mitigation in place.
jordan (ceo): Quick FYI to execs: monitoring shows client impact was limited to 0.3% of requests — good containment but we need the fixes to avoid recurrence.
kevin (sre): I'll post the canary results to this thread after 2026-03-26 checkpoint.
elena (prod): Closing thread for now — please update the RCA doc for any changes.
